items.caption:
oh to be young and financially literate..

YOU CAN BE!! 

if i could tell my younger self where to start, it be this

1. invest before you feel ready 

So many people think you need thousands to start investing when in reality, if you started investing just $100 a month at age 20 by retirement you could have over $1 million🫠 now imagine $200 or $300 a month..:

2. create another stream of income

Do you know how easy it is nowadays to make an extra $100-200 a month? there are literally endlessss side hustles and extra ways to make money in 2026. dog walking, instacart, furniture flipping, serving tables, 

AND content creation!! Whatever it is that you do start filming it in that can become just one more stream of income (probably the biggest one yet!)

if you want to make money online but don’t know where to start comment “ready” and i’ll send you my step by step training! 💸

3. Learn how money works

nobody is born financially literate y’all 😭 it’s up to you to go out there and listen to podcasts, watch YouTube videos, and follow people who teach personal finance. The more you understand topics like budgeting, investing, taxes, credit cards, banking, & increasing your income the more confident you’ll become making financial decisions😌

if you want to become more financially literate comment “finance” and i’ll send you my free finance guide 📈🫶🏻
